measurement_plan_order_of_operations: STEP 0 (repro gate): load all inputs once; verify SB1 series reproduces Track V full_sr_net 0.9566 (4dp). SB2 fresh run via trackv_engine cfg above. Truncate everything at 2026-04-30.

STEP 1 (correlation gatekeeper, per spec): cor_primary = cor(spec_net, book_L5_net) on the FULL common window; cor_diag = cor(spec_net, ret_orig) reported as diagnostic. If |cor_primary| >= 0.30 -> verdict DISQUALIFIED_BOOK_MARGINAL, report immediately, and DO NOT measure the blend grid for that spec (no salvage, no forking).

STEP 2 (blend grid, only if STEP 1 passes): blends = Return.portfolio(R = cbind(book_L5_net, spec_net), weights = (w_book, 1-w_book), rebalance_on = 'months') for the FROZEN grid w_book in {0.90, 0.85, 0.80, 0.75}. NO hand-weighted return sums (w1*r1+w2*r2 self-synthesis prohibited; precedent value_sleeve_combination/run_blend.R).
STEP 3 (IS-only selection): argmax IS delta_IR_samebasis over the 4 grid points; tie-break (|d| < 0.005): lower IS MDD. IS winner committed to the results file BEFORE any OOS value is inspected.
STEP 4 (OOS confirm, once): evaluate the committed blend point on OOS; then FULL-window G2/G3 verdicts.
STEP 5 (report): all arms, all windows, both specs, including failures/disqualifications. metric_type labels on every number.

judgment_criteria_preregistered.G3_oos_nonworsening: At the committed blend point: OOS delta_IR_samebasis >= 0 AND OOS delta_SR (blend - book-only) >= 0 (point estimates, single consultation).
judgment_criteria_preregistered.verdict_rule: STAGE_B_PASS requires G1 AND G2 AND G3. Any failure -> honest FAIL report with the failing leg named; no second pick from OOS; no grid extension.
